title: Carved Spoon
description: A carved spoon is shaped from a single blank of hardwood, with a bowl hollowed by gouge and a handle shaped to the hand. This guide carves a 10 inch spoon from maple, starting with a 10 by 2 by 1 inch blank, roughing the outline with a saw, hollowing the bowl, and finishing with food-safe oil. The bowl holds about 2 tablespoons, the handle is oval in section for grip, and the spoon is sanded to 220 grit before oiling.

specs.tolerances: Bowl depth 1/2 in plus or minus 1/16 in; handle oval within 1/16 in.
specs.arithmetic_note: Cut list totals: 1 pieces, total linear length 10 in, total board feet 0.14. Overall dimensions 10 x 2 x 1 in in are consistent with the primary pieces: the longest piece does not exceed the longest overall dimension, and every piece dimension is positive with qty of at least 1.

steps: Draw the spoon outline on the blank.
Saw the outline and shape the handle oval.
Hollow the bowl with a gouge, working with the grain.
Sand through the grits to 220.
Oil with food-safe oil, let it cure, and re-oil.

tools.safety_notes: Wear eye and hearing protection whenever power tools run; keep blades guarded and hands behind the cutting edge; carve away from the body with the non-dominant hand behind the blade; never present an unsafe cut as acceptable.

demo.code:
# Cut-list board-foot calculator (board feet = L x W x T / 144, per piece x qty)
CUTS = [('blank', 10, 2, 1, 1)]
total_bf = 0.0
for piece, length, width, thick, qty in CUTS:
    bf = length * width * thick / 144.0 * qty
    total_bf += bf
    print("%s: %.2f board feet" % (piece, bf))
print("Overall dimensions: 10 x 2 x 1 in in")
print("Total board feet: %.2f" % total_bf)
print("Pieces: %d" % sum(q for _, _, _, _, q in CUTS))
demo.expected_output:

Overall dimensions: 10 x 2 x 1 in in
Total board feet: 0.14
Pieces: 1

title: Scroll-Sawn Ornament
description: A scroll-sawn ornament is a thin, pierced shape cut on a scroll saw, often a star, snowflake, or animal silhouette. This guide cuts a 4 inch star ornament from 1/4 inch birch plywood, drilling blade-entry holes for interior cuts, following the pattern line, and sanding edges before finishing with clear varnish. The ornament hangs from a small drilled hole with twine.

title: Carved Wooden Sign

This guide carves a 24 by 8 inch sign from cedar, laying out 3 inch letters, carving with a V-tool and gouge, and finishing with exterior oil and painted letters. Letter spacing is set by eye with a story stick, grain runs horizontally so letters do not split, and the sign hangs from two screw eyes.

title: Decorative Molding Sampler
description: A decorative molding sampler is a display board showing router and plane profiles side by side, used to choose trim for a room. This guide builds a 24 by 12 inch sampler board from pine with six profiles: ogee, cove, bead, chamfer, roundover, and dentil, each labeled. title: Turned Bowl Basics
description: A turned bowl is hollowed on a lathe from a single blank, with walls of even thickness and a foot that sits flat. This guide turns a 10 inch diameter bowl, 4 inches high, from maple, mounting the blank on a faceplate, roughing the outside, hollowing the inside to 3/8 inch walls, and sanding through the grits before food-safe oil. The bowl is checked for wall thickness with calipers at several points, and the foot is turned to sit without rocking.

title: Turned Vase Basics

title: Intarsia Animal Plaque Basics

title: Wooden Wall Art Panel
description: A wooden wall art panel is a large, flat composition of wood strips, shapes, or carving mounted as art. This guide builds a 36 by 24 inch panel from mixed hardwoods, arranging strips of walnut, maple, and cherry in a geometric pattern, gluing them to a plywood backing, leveling the face, and finishing with clear oil. The panel hangs from a French cleat rated for its weight, and the pattern is balanced so no side feels heavier.
